evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: The requirement of a signed manifest before shipping appeals to security and stability — keeping deploys safe and controlled.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Citing past failures as justification for a gate appeals to conservation (preventing recurrence) and competence (quality control over what reaches staging).
The gate specification frames a security requirement as a mandatory condition — conservation of deploy integrity.
Extending the gate's scope across environments appeals to conservation — blanket security coverage.
Naming an individual owner frames accountability as personal standing — the owner's role as gatekeeper appeals to achievement and responsibility.
